notes.title: Picture Books & Continues! Update information on 12/22
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33722220/f82749dc55dbb26a7a5f12cc8463ea19c994e344.png
The Black Bird flies again! We just updated the game to add the new storybooks which the PS4/5 versions launched with recently and added continue functionality too!

 Added two secret picture books as rewards for finishing the game
 Added CONTINUE functionality at game over

Enjoy

notes.title: Black Bird is now fully Mac compatible!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36291387/1744d74544960d5aa629c98a6db85e679587f3ef.png

Hello to all our Onion fans on Macs! 

As you might have noticed, we've just updated our award-winning operatic side-scrolling shooter BLACK BIRD to be fully 64-bit Mac compatible! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/857500/BLACK_BIRD/

You can now freely download BLACK BIRD to your Mac on Catalina and above! We hope that if you love our other games, but haven't yet tried BLACK BIRD, you'll take the opportunity to complete your Onion collection with your new favorite shooter! Find out why it's been praised by critics all across the world!

"90/100 — It's a masterpiece of modern shooting games, perfect for beginners and experienced players."
- Shin Imai, IGN Japan

"Black Bird is difficult, weird, and an utterly brilliant shmup you need to check out right now."
- Ric Cowley, Pocket Gamer

"Black Bird is stunning. It’s rare to see a project so finely tuned, so perfectly balanced, confidently paced and smartly constructed."
- Brad Gallaway, GameCritics

CLICK HERE TO BUY BLACK BIRD ON STEAM

Don't forget! You can also join our mailing list — THE SECRET ONION CELLAR — for the inside scoop on upcoming games, and more! When you join, you'll get AN EXCLUSIVE FREE GAME, soundtrack samplers, and wallpapers from all our games! You can't get this stuff anywhere else! Click here to join!

notes.title: Update: Now compatible with 64bit Mac OS!
notes.content: Today's update should remove the error some players were getting when trying to play the game on a 64bit Mac OS.
